days.title: Waterfalls and Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Krimml Waterfalls
stops.detail: The Krimml Waterfalls in the Hohe Tauern National Park are the highest waterfalls in Europe.

stops.name: lowest waterfall
stops.detail: The barrier-free path leads from the car parks to the lowest waterfall, including wheelchair-accessible toilets.

stops.name: uppermost waterfall
stops.detail: Those continuing to the uppermost waterfall should be reasonably fit and sure-footed.

stops.name: Krimml Waterfall Trail
stops.detail: The Krimml Waterfall Trail is open every day from 1st May until the end of October (admission fee applies).

stops.name: Krimml WaterWorlds
stops.detail: The Krimml WaterWorlds offer an interactive experience centred around the element of water, located right next to the Krimml Waterfalls.

stops.name: village of Krimml
stops.detail: The Krimml Waterfalls are situated in the village of Krimml in the Hohe Tauern National Park in SalzburgerLand.

stops.name: Tauern Cycle Path
stops.detail: A leisurely ride along great rivers, cultural highlights and culinary discoveries: the Tauern Cycle Path through the Alps never fails to impress.
